views: view1: แบบโครงสร้างหลังคา 1:75 — main mono-pitch roof (T1/T2/T3), with the หมายเหตุ line-type legend
view2: untitled 1:75 plan of the lean-to roof over grid 2-3 (T2/T4/T5, อะเส)
warnings: Line types from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend: thin = แป C-75x45x15x2.3 mm. @1.50 m., heavy dash-dot = อะเส C-100x50x20x2.3 mm., and one line pattern each for TRUSS T1-T5. Main roof is a mono-pitch steel roof: T3 on grid 1 (low side), T2 on grid 2 (high side), T1 across rows A, B, C and E.

T1 segments are split at the T3/T2 supports; the 1.00 overhangs to the eave 1' and to the roof edge 2'' are the truss top chord / rafter only (Truss T1 on S-04 draws the top chord running about 1.00 past both ends) — recorded as their own T1 segments flagged top_chord_only.

T2 is drawn from E up to the eave A' on both S-03 views, but the Truss T2 elevation spans only E to A (7.50). The A'-A piece is kept as a low-confidence T2 segment (never dropped) — on the T2 elevation the line overhanging A is the lean-to roof's sloping rafter, so the member is unclear.
T2 lies on grid 2 between the two roofs and is drawn on both views; it is recorded only in this view-1 file so the BOQ does not count it twice.
Purlins carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Their individual positions are not dimensioned, so they are one element with count + area ref, not grid lines.

elements.note: เส้น T2 บนแปลนลากต่อจาก A ขึ้นไปถึงชายคา A' แต่รูป Truss T2 (S-04) ช่วงเต็ม E-A 7.50 ไม่มีส่วนยื่น — เส้นที่ยื่นเลย A บนรูป T2 คือจันทันของหลังคาเพิงที่พาดผ่าน ระบุชิ้นส่วนไม่ชัด
